sections.title: Welcome to the Quest
sections.text: Explore the platform through guided tours and unlock new levels as you earn points.

sections.title: Play to Learn
sections.text: Each level is a short interactive tour of a module. Finish the tour to advance.

sections.title: Stay in Control
sections.text: Track your progress and unlock new missions as you go.

welcome.title: Cryocan Quality Tracking
welcome.subtitle: Level 1 · Branch Mission
welcome.description: Zoom into individual branch performance. Learn to filter, compare, and act on branch-level data to keep every location running smoothly.

quick_start.message: Take a quick guided tour to see how to filter, compare, and act on branch-level cryocan data.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored branch-level data. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Branch Expert!
completion.message: You can drill into any branch and read its performance snapshot at a glance. Branch data holds no secrets for you.

quick_exit.title: Branch Expert!
quick_exit.message: You can drill into any branch and read its performance snapshot at a glance.

welcome.title: Alert Configuration
welcome.subtitle: Level 2 · Alert Mission
welcome.description: Set up and fine-tune alert thresholds so your clinic never misses a critical LN2 event. Stay one step ahead of every warning.

quick_start.message: Take a quick guided tour to see how to set alert thresholds and notification rules for each device and KPI.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored the alert settings. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: Alerts Configured!
completion.message: Your clinic's alert system is now fully under your control. Every critical event will reach the right person at the right time.

quick_exit.title: Alerts Configured!
quick_exit.message: Your clinic's alert system is now fully under your control.

welcome.title: Profile
welcome.subtitle: Level 3 · Identity Mission
welcome.description: Manage your personal information, review your support ticket history, and configure your notification preferences all in one place.

quick_start.message: Take a quick guided tour of your profile — personal info, support tickets, and notification preferences.

interlude.title: Nice work! Tour complete.
interlude.message: You've explored your Profile. Here's what you covered:

completion.title: You're All Set!
completion.message: You've completed the Vyrona onboarding — from tracking cryocan quality and configuring alerts to managing your profile. You're ready to run your clinic at full power.

quick_exit.title: Profile Complete!
quick_exit.message: You know exactly where to update your info, track support, and manage notifications.
